cases.description: One past transcript, no config, no CRM — the common OSS starting point.
cases.prompt: Prep me for my call with Northwind Robotics tomorrow. Here's the last call: [paste skills/call-prep-note/assets/sample-transcripts.md, Call 1 only]
expectations: Note has exactly 4 parts: Hook, Win condition, Your 3 moves, Watch out for
Hook cites the price objection with a quote or paraphrase attributed to Sam Patel
Exactly 3 moves, numbered literally 1. 2. 3., none repeated
No AMA links, no utm_ params, no 'how top reps do this' labels
No em-dashes anywhere in the note

cases.description: Meeting named, nothing else — no transcript, no config, no CRM.
cases.prompt: Prep note for my call with Northwind Robotics this afternoon.
expectations: Skill asks at most 3 targeted questions before generating
Never refuses outright and never silently returns nothing
Hook uses the 'no history yet' state, not an invented risk

cases.description: Two chronological transcripts of the same account plus a written prep-note-config.md with a custom stage ladder.
cases.prompt: Prep me for the Northwind Robotics follow-up call. Both past calls attached: [paste skills/call-prep-note/assets/sample-transcripts.md, both calls]. My prep-note-config.md defines stage 'Evaluation' with exit criteria: success criteria written, POC owner named, decision date set.
expectations: Moves reference the configured stage's exit criteria, not the generic fallback ladder
Ranks Call 2 above Call 1 as the more recent, same-attendee call
Win condition names Dana Cole and a concrete, call-specific result, not the deal outcome

cases.description: All attendees share the user's own domain.
cases.prompt: Prep note for my 1:1 sync with our own eng lead, both of us @acme.com.
expectations: Output is exactly: 'No prep note. This looks like an internal call.'
No hook, win condition, moves, or watch-outs printed
